answer: To resist Sybil attacks, each agent reporting sensor data from a coastal wharf or an upland mesa must lock 50 POA and run a 15-minute sequential VDF authenticated via a sonnet proof. Voting weight is strictly capped at one unit. Minting each fake burns 2 in compute and locks 50 POA, while epoch emission is capped at 2 POA per seat. Because the un-parallelizable physical cost of 2 per identity strictly exceeds the maximum 2 POA reward, deploying hundreds of individually compliant fakes guarantees net capital loss, eliminating profitable automated clone generation.
